mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate for equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined for 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.0% for two consecutive months, it signals a weak labor market that prompts central bank policy accommodation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE has been above 5.0% for two consecutive months, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and a rise in consumer credit (RSAFS) indicates a weakening housing market and increasing consumer leverage, which together signal an impending economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where HOUST declines and RSAFS rises simultaneously, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO < 95.0), a contraction in manufacturing output signals an economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where INDPRO is below 95.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in consumer credit (RSAFS) over the past 6 months indicates rising consumer spending, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where RSAFS has increased for 6 consecutive months, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in CPI (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 2.5%, it signals persistent inflation that may trigger a monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY change exceeds 2.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in employment growth (PAYEMS) and a rise in unemployment (UNRATE) indicates a deteriorating labor market, which together signal negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises simultaneously, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of strong housing starts (HOUST > 560.0), a robust housing market signals economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where HOUST exceeds 560.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.
